description: This PHP source file defines the Special controller class within the Opencart admin module extension. It handles displaying, saving, adding, and deleting 'special' modules, including generating the admin interface view and processing requests for module configurations.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for managing special modules in the Opencart admin panel, providing methods for rendering the module configuration page and performing CRUD operations on modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the special module configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, module data, and output view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save modifications to a special module, including permission check, validation, and database update.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to add a new special module, ensuring proper permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to delete a specified module by ID, with permission verification.
